think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numerical knob with an inherent ordering. 3) If numerical, look for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that trigger a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) and thus break the natural order. 4) If the knob is not numerical (e.g., string/enum/boolean), it does not fit the definition of a ‘special numerical knob’ in this question. 5) Conclude special_knob=true only if such a sentinel numeric value exists; otherwise false, and report the special value if applicable.
